purpose: Verify user with authorized role is permitted to perform OAP action
preconditions: Student user is authenticated with student role
action_or_input: Student submits a leave application
expected_result: Action is permitted and request is processed

purpose: Verify user with unauthorized role is refused access to protected OAP function
preconditions: User is authenticated with faculty role without HoD privilege
action_or_input: User attempts to approve a leave application
expected_result: Action is refused and status remains unchanged

purpose: Verify user cannot view or modify OAP records outside their assigned scope
preconditions: Student A submits leave application; Student B is authenticated
action_or_input: Student B attempts to query Student A's leave record
expected_result: Record is not returned (404/403) and no cross-student data is leaked

purpose: Verify required notifications are generated across alert and email channels
preconditions: An OAP notification event is triggered
action_or_input: Inspect created notification records for the event
expected_result: Notification records exist for both alert and email channels; SMS is not created

purpose: Verify only HoD can approve or reject student leave applications
preconditions: Leave application is in submitted state; HoD of department is authenticated
action_or_input: HoD approves or rejects the leave application
expected_result: Decision is successfully recorded and application status updated

purpose: Verify non-HoD actor cannot decide student leave application
preconditions: Leave application is submitted; Academic Administrator or Student is authenticated
action_or_input: Non-HoD user attempts to approve or reject leave application
expected_result: Decision is refused and application remains in submitted state

purpose: Verify Academic Administrator is authorized to verify and decide bonafide requests
preconditions: Bonafide request is submitted; Academic Administrator is authenticated
action_or_input: Academic Administrator verifies request and records approval decision
expected_result: Verification and decision are persisted successfully

purpose: Verify non-Academic Administrator actor cannot verify or decide bonafide requests
preconditions: Bonafide request is submitted; HoD or Student is authenticated
action_or_input: Non-Academic Administrator attempts to decide bonafide request
expected_result: Decision is refused with authorization error

purpose: Verify bonafide certificate download is permitted when request is approved
preconditions: Bonafide request has status Approved
action_or_input: Student requests bonafide certificate download
expected_result: Download succeeds and certificate metadata/content is provided

purpose: Verify bonafide certificate download is prohibited when request is not approved
preconditions: Bonafide request is in submitted or rejected state
action_or_input: Student attempts to download bonafide certificate
expected_result: Download is refused and no certificate is provided

purpose: Verify clearance authority records result for its own domain
preconditions: No-dues case exists; Librarian is authenticated
action_or_input: Librarian records Clear for Library domain
expected_result: Library clearance is recorded as Clear

purpose: Verify clearance authority cannot record result for another domain
preconditions: No-dues case exists; Librarian is authenticated
action_or_input: Librarian attempts to record clearance for Hostel domain
expected_result: Action is refused and Hostel clearance is not updated

purpose: Verify recording result for one domain leaves other six domain statuses unchanged
preconditions: No-dues case has 7 initial pending domains
action_or_input: Mess In-charge records Clear for Mess domain; inspect all 7 domain rows
expected_result: Only Mess domain is updated; the other 6 domains remain in their exact prior states

purpose: Verify finalization permitted when all seven mandatory clearances are Clear
preconditions: All seven domain clearances (Library, Hostel, Mess, Dept, Lab, Acad, Student) are Clear
action_or_input: Academic Administrator finalizes the no-dues case
expected_result: Case status transitions to Finalized

purpose: Verify finalization prohibited when at least one authority records dues outstanding
preconditions: 6 domains are Clear, 1 domain is Outstanding
action_or_input: Academic Administrator attempts finalization
expected_result: Finalization is refused and case remains in progress

purpose: Verify finalization prohibited when at least one authority verification is pending
preconditions: 6 domains are Clear, 1 domain is Pending
action_or_input: Academic Administrator attempts finalization
expected_result: Finalization is refused and case remains in progress

purpose: Verify no-dues certificate download is permitted after finalization
preconditions: No-dues case is in Finalized state
action_or_input: Student requests no-dues certificate download
expected_result: Certificate access is granted

purpose: Verify no-dues certificate download is prohibited prior to finalization
preconditions: No-dues case is in progress (not finalized)
action_or_input: Student attempts to download no-dues certificate
expected_result: Download is refused and no certificate is provided

purpose: Verify PG student is permitted to submit assistantship claims
preconditions: Student is authenticated with PG status and has assigned supervisors
action_or_input: PG student submits assistantship claim
expected_result: Claim is created in submitted state

purpose: Verify non-PG student is prohibited from submitting assistantship claims
preconditions: Student is authenticated with UG status
action_or_input: UG student attempts to submit assistantship claim
expected_result: Claim submission is refused

purpose: Verify assistantship claim requires verifications in both Thesis and TA supervisor roles
preconditions: Claim is submitted
action_or_input: Record Thesis verification, check readiness for Dept review; record TA verification, check readiness
expected_result: Department review is blocked after one verification; permitted only after both role-verifications are recorded

purpose: Verify dual supervisor verifications can be recorded in either order (TA before Thesis)
preconditions: Claim is submitted with assigned Thesis and TA supervisors
action_or_input: Record TA supervisor verification first, then Thesis supervisor verification
expected_result: Both verifications are accepted and claim becomes ready for Department review

purpose: Verify Department Administrator review is prohibited if either supervisor verification is missing
preconditions: Claim has only 1 supervisor verification recorded
action_or_input: Department Administrator attempts to forward claim to HoD
expected_result: Forwarding is refused due to missing supervisor verification

purpose: Verify HoD is authorized to approve or reject assistantship claims
preconditions: Claim has been reviewed and forwarded by Department Administrator
action_or_input: HoD approves or rejects the claim
expected_result: Decision is successfully persisted and status updated

purpose: Verify non-HoD actor cannot approve or reject assistantship claim
preconditions: Claim has been forwarded to HoD; Department Administrator is authenticated
action_or_input: Department Administrator attempts to approve claim
expected_result: Action is refused with authorization error

purpose: Verify stipend disbursement processing is permitted for HoD-approved claim
preconditions: Claim has status Approved
action_or_input: Academic Administrator processes stipend disbursement
expected_result: Stipend disbursement is recorded as processed

purpose: Verify stipend disbursement processing is prohibited for claim that is not HoD-approved
preconditions: Claim is in submitted or rejected state
action_or_input: Academic Administrator attempts to process stipend disbursement
expected_result: Action is refused and stipend is not processed

purpose: Verify assistantship claim cannot bypass required stages in sequence
preconditions: Claim is newly submitted
action_or_input: Attempt to jump directly to HoD decision or stipend processing without supervisor verifications and department forward
expected_result: Out-of-sequence transitions are refused

purpose: Verify Department Administrator records thesis supervisor and TA assignments
preconditions: Department Administrator is authenticated
action_or_input: Record thesis supervisor and TA assignment
expected_result: Assignments are recorded successfully

purpose: Verify same faculty member can hold both Thesis and TA supervisor roles with distinct verifications
preconditions: Faculty member is assigned as both Thesis and TA supervisor for student
action_or_input: Faculty member submits verification for thesis role, then verification for TA role
expected_result: System records two separate verification rows for the claim

purpose: Verify PG student is permitted to request graduate seminar scheduling
preconditions: Student holds PG status
action_or_input: PG student requests seminar scheduling
expected_result: Seminar request is created in awaiting_scheduling state

purpose: Verify UG student is prohibited from requesting graduate seminar scheduling
preconditions: Student holds UG status
action_or_input: UG student attempts to request seminar scheduling
expected_result: Request is refused

purpose: Verify Department Administrator schedules and logs graduate seminars without separate approval stage
preconditions: Seminar request is awaiting scheduling; Department Administrator is authenticated
action_or_input: Department Administrator assigns datetime and venue
expected_result: Seminar schedule is logged and state transitions to Scheduled

purpose: Verify graduate seminar schedules are visible to PG students and faculty
preconditions: Graduate seminars are scheduled
action_or_input: PG student and faculty member query seminar schedules
expected_result: Scheduled seminars are retrievable and visible
